```

```

      --namespace string         Filter by pod namespace

      --pod string               Filter by pod name
      --program string           Filter by hook program name
      --shell-sock-path string   Path to the shell UNIX socket (default "/var/run/cilium/shell.sock")

      --type string              Filter by hook type (PRE, POST)
